description: This file is a Node.js script used for auditing links within documentation files in a project. It reads configuration and markdown files, resolves routes, detects broken links, and includes CLI functionality for running link audits.

methods.name: walk
methods.description: Recursively collects all files within a directory, excluding hidden entries.

methods.name: normalizeSlashes
methods.description: Converts backslashes to forward slashes in a path for consistency.

methods.name: isLocalizedDocPath
methods.description: Determines if a path corresponds to a localized documentation path based on language code pattern.

methods.name: isGeneratedTranslatedDoc
methods.description: Checks if a documentation path is a generated translation.

methods.name: collectNavPageEntries
methods.description: Recursively collects navigation page entries from the navigation configuration.

methods.name: sanitizeDocsConfigForEnglishOnly
methods.description: Removes or filters out non-English or localized documentation configurations.

methods.name: resolveRoute
methods.description: Resolves a route, following redirects, and reports whether the final route is published.

methods.name: auditDocsLinks
methods.description: Audits all links in markdown documentation files, identifying broken links.

methods.name: runDocsLinkAuditCli
methods.description: CLI entry point for running the link audit, optionally checking anchor links.
